source: 718 Another Warning
target: 718 Altera Monitio

source: Lumian and Anthony only had to wait briefly before the ministers began exiting the Pavilion of Pleasure one by one.
target: Lumian et Anthony breviter exspectare debebant, priusquam ministros singillatim ex Atrio Voluptatis exire coeperunt.

source: They quickly approached Moran Avigny, the Minister of Industry.
target: Celeriter accesserunt ad Moran Avigny, Minister Industriae.

source: While listening to the other reporters’ questions, they employed their unique abilities to observe him closely.
target: Dum quaestiones aliorum relatorum audiebant, singulares facultates ad eum diligenter observandum adhibuerunt.

source: After just over ten seconds, Lumian turned to Anthony and gave a small shake of his head,
target: Post paulo plus quam decem secundae, Lumian ad Anthony conversus est et caput leviter submovit.

source: indicating that, for now, there was nothing unusual about Moran’s river of fate.
target: Id indicans quod, pro tempore, nihil insolitum de flumine fati Moran erat.

source: He trusted that Anthony, being a Spectator, would understand his unspoken message.
target: Fidit Antonium, Spectatorem esse, tacitum nuntium eius intellegaturum.

source: Anthony responded with a slight head shake of his own, confirming to Lumian that Moran Avigny’s expression and behavior appeared normal.
target: Anthony respondit caput leviter submovens, Lumiano confirmans expressionem atque mores Moran Avigny esse normales.

source: Has the Overseer directly responsible for Jebus not reached out to Moran Avigny?
target: Num Praefectus, qui Jebus directe curabat, non accessit ad Moran Avigny?

source: Or could our assumption be incorrect?
target: An nostra coniectura fortasse errata sit?

source: Is it possible that Jebus’s death wasn’t detected by the Overseer’s monitoring?
target: Possibile est, ut mors Jebus vigilantia Praefecti non deprehensa sit?

source: Have they not fully grasped the situation with Jebus?
target: Num non plene intellexerunt rem de Jebus?

source: These thoughts raced through Lumian’s mind as he continued his observation.
target: Hae cogitationes per mentem Lumiani festinanter transierunt, dum observationem continuabat.

source: This was precisely why he had come in person to the Pavilion of Pleasure to await Moran Avigny’s appearance.
target: Hac quidem causa ipse ad Atrium Voluptatis venit ut apparitionem Moran Avigny exspectaret.

source: Only by acquiring the most current and reliable information could he assess whether to move forward with the original plan, adjust it, or temporarily set it aside!
target: Nimirum, per recentissimas atque fideles notitias acquisitas, potuisset aestimare utrum consilium originale prosequi, id accommodare, aut temporarie deponere valeat!

source: Indeed, within Moran Avigny’s river of fate, a tributary of him entering the full-body mirror in the study still exists, shrouded in an intense black hue…
target: Revera, in flumine fati Moran Avigny, ramus eius, qui in speculum totius corporis in studio ingreditur, adhuc existit, in nigro intensissimo involutus…

source: Lumian, unconcerned about the drain on his spirituality, maintained his focus on any potential shifts in Moran Avigny’s destiny.
target: Lumian, detrimento spiritualitatis suae non sollicitus, intentionem suam ad qualibet mutatione in fato Moran Avigny retinuit.

source: Following a short interview, the debonair Minister of Industry, flanked by his bodyguards, descended the steps of the Pavilion of Pleasure and headed towards his stylish four-wheeled, four-seater carriage.
target: Post breve colloquium, elegans Minister Industriae, cum custodibus suis, gradus Atrii Voluptatis descendit et ad raedam suam elegantem, quaterna rotis et quattuor sedibus dispositam, se contulit.

source: As the valet opened the carriage door, Moran Avigny pulled out a small hand mirror from his pocket, seemingly checking his appearance.
target: Dum servus ianuam raedae aperiebat, Moran Avigny speculum parvum ad manum pertinens de sinu suo extraxit, quasi aspectum suum inspiciens.

source: In Trier’s high society, this was a typical occurrence.
target: In societate alta Treverorum, hoc eventus solitus erat.

source: Men’s cosmetics and grooming had long been in vogue.
target: Cosmetica virorum et cultus corporis diu in more erant.

source: Moran Avigny peered into the hand mirror, his dark-gray pupils abruptly widening as his expression subtly changed.
target: Moran Avigny in speculum parvum aspexit, pupillae eius fuscogriseae subito dilatantes, dum vultus eius subtiliter mutabatur.

source: Nearly simultaneously, Lumian, with his silver-black eyes, detected a notable alteration in the Minister of Industry’s fate tributary.
target: Paene simul, Lumian, oculis argenteo-nigris, mutationem notabilem in ramo fati Ministri Industriae animadvertit.

source: None of the tributaries suggested Moran Avigny’s entry into the study’s full-body mirror!
target: Nullus ex ramis indicabat ingressum Moran Avigny in speculum totius corporis studii!

source: All relevant “choices” had vanished!
target: Omnes optiones pertinentes evanuerunt!

source: As a result, even if Lumian depleted nearly half of his spirituality and employed Compelling Fate, he would be unable to force Moran Avigny to “willingly” enter the study’s full-body mirror.
target: Consequenter, etiamsi Lumian paene dimidium spiritualitatis suae consumpsisset et Fatum Coercendum adhibuisset, non potuisset cogere Moran Avigny ut "volenter" in speculum totius corporis in studio ingrediatur.

source: Compelling Fate wasn’t about creating destiny; choices had to exist before they could be compelled!
target: Fatum Coercendum non significabat fatum creare; optiones prius exsistere debebant, ut compelli possent!

source: Taking advantage of the moment when the reporters had shifted their focus and the two of them were slowly trailing behind, Anthony quietly said to Lumian, “When Moran Avigny looked at himself in the hand mirror, he experienced a palpable sense of fear.”
target: Uti momenti quo relatores attentionem mutaverant et duo eorum lente se sequerantur, Anthony silentio Lumiano inquit: "Cum Moran Avigny in speculum parvum se aspexit, sensum timoris perceptum habuit."

source: As Lumian followed the other reporters, he continued to assess Moran Avigny and formed a related hypothesis.
target: Dum Lumian alios relatores sequebatur, Moran Avigny percontari continuavit et hypothesim affinitatem formavit.

source: Someone was utilizing the mirror world and the hand mirror to convey a message to Moran Avigny!
target: Aliquis mundum specularum et speculum parvum ad manum utebatur, ut nuntium ad Moran Avigny mitteret!

source: The transmitted information likely pertained to the mysterious demise of Jebus Lata, who was tasked with guarding the study’s full-body mirror, and the disappearance of his body.
target: Notitia transmissae probabiliter attinebat ad obscuram interitum Jebus Lata, qui speculum totius corporis in studio custodire curabatur, et ad eius corporis evanitionem.

source: For Moran Avigny, this implied that someone was conspiring against him. The shadow was already looming over him, its source and circumstances unknown.
target: Pro Moran Avigny, hoc significabat aliquem adversum se conspirare; umbra iam super eum imminebat, origo atque circumstantiae ignotae.

source: Under such conditions, fear was inevitable. For the majority of people, emotions would inevitably manifest to some degree in their facial expressions and physical movements, making them readily apparent to Spectators.
target: Sub his condicionibus, timor inevitabilis erat. Plurimis hominibus, affectus in vultibus et motibus corporis manifestabantur, facientes eos ab Spectatoribus manifeste agnoscibiles.

source: Yes, given that Jebus possessed a Mirror Cufflink, it’s reasonable to assume that the Overseer above him would have comparable items.
target: Ita, cum Jebus fibulam specularis possidebat, rationabile est putare Praefectum super eum similia habere.

source: They might even possess the additional capability to communicate via the mirror world… Lumian recalled, thinking of the glass cufflink now in Franca’s possession.
target: Forsitan etiam additam facultatem ad per mundum specularum communicandum possiderint… Lumian recordatus est, cogitans de fibula vitrea nunc in Francae possessione.

source: Moreover, Jebus had disclosed that Moran Avigny had instructed the other Mirror People from the Tamara family to assume new identities and relocate, leaving him as the sole contact with the School of Truth.
target: Praeterea, Jebus enuntiaverat Moran Avigny reliquos Speculares ex familia Tamara hortatum esse ut novas identitates acciperent et migrarent, relinquens se solum vinculum cum Schola Veritatis.

source: Consequently, when the Overseer discovered Jebus’s unexplained disappearance and ultimate death, they would be unable to reach the other Mirror People.
target: Consequenter, cum Praefectus Jebus inexplicatam evanitionem atque ultimam mortem detegisset, reliquos Speculares attingere non potuit.

source: They could only await the conclusion of Moran Avigny’s ministerial meeting to send him a warning.
target: Illi tantum exspectare poterant finem conventus ministeriali Moran Avigny, ut ei monitum mitterent.

source: Our prior conjectures have been validated. The Overseer did indeed detect Jebus’s death.
target: Conjecturae nostrae priores confirmatae sunt. Praefectus vere mortem Jebus detexit.

source: Whether the Overseer was limited by his abilities or hindered by the Primordial Demoness figurine is uncertain, but he was unable to immediately locate us and launch a counterattack…
target: Utrum Praefectus facultatibus suis limitatus sit an figura Daemonae Primordialis eum impeditis sit incertum est; sed nos statim invenire et contra impetum iniicere non potuit…

source: We must abandon the original plan. Getting Moran Avigny to ‘willingly’ enter the study’s full-body mirror is no longer feasible…
target: Consilium originale deserendum est. Neque iam fieri potest ut Moran Avigny "volenter" in speculum totius corporis in studio ingrediatur…

source: Lost in thought, Lumian watched as Moran Avigny tucked away the hand mirror, boarded the carriage, and headed home.
target: Cogitatione absorptus, Lumian spectavit dum Moran Avigny speculum parvum ad manum recondidit, raedam conscendit et domum profectus est.

source: Taking advantage of the still somewhat chaotic scene, he and Anthony discreetly left the Pavilion of Pleasure.
target: Ex scena adhuc aliquantisper mixta, ille et Anthony caute Atrium Voluptatis reliquerunt.

source: At the periphery of a square adorned with statues and obelisks, Lumian scanned his surroundings.
target: In margine plateae ornatae statuis et obeliscis, Lumian ambitum suum circumspiciebat.

source: Confirming that no one was nearby, he murmured to Anthony, “What do you think frightened Moran Avigny?”
target: Confirmans neminem prope esse, ad Anthony murmuravit: "Quid putas quod Moran Avigny territus sit?"

source: He had already shared his theory with Anthony.
target: Iam theoriam suam cum Anthony communicaverat.

source: Drawing on his Spectator perspective, Anthony endeavored to analyze the psychological states of the School of Truth and Moran Avigny.
target: Ex sua Spectatoris prospectu, Anthony conatus est condiciones psychologicas Scholae Veritatis atque Moran Avigny perpendere.

source: “Without intel on the enemy, it’s improbable that the School of Truth, a secret organization worshiping an evil deity, would dispatch additional demigod-level operatives to Moran Avigny’s proximity to enhance protection for the Mirror People.
target: Sine indagatione de hoste, improbabile est Schola Veritatis, societas arcana deum malum colens, operarios ad gradum semi-deorum ad propinquitatem Moran Avigny mittere posse, ut speculares tueatur.

source: Unlike an orthodox Church, they can’t afford to act rashly and perpetually escalate their involvement.
target: Contra Ecclesiam orthodoxam, non desunt eis opes ut imprudenter agant et in sua implicatione continuo augeantur.

source: They must consider the possibility that the group that apprehended Jebus is equally formidable, potentially including a demigod in their ranks.
target: Rationem habere debent possibilitatis, quod coetus qui Jebus apprehendit, aeque formidabilis sit, fortasse etiam semideus in ordinibus suis continens.

source: They might even suspect that this could be a covert mission orchestrated by the Purifier, Machinery Hivemind, or an elite unit from Bureau 8.
target: Forsitan etiam suspicari possint hanc esse missionem occultam a Purificatore, Machinae Communis, aut unitate electa ex Bureau VIII.

source: In essence, the Overseer will convey to Moran Avigny that he’s now on his own. They’ll offer indirect support but can’t intervene directly.
target: Praeterea, Praefectus ipse ad Moran Avigny indicabit eum nunc solum esse; subsidium indirectum offerent, sed directe intervenire non possunt.

source: Other cults might react with insanity, extremism, and irrationality while still defending Moran Avigny. However, based on Jebus’s ideology, the School of Truth will refrain from such actions.
target: Aliae sectae insanitate, extremismo, et irratione agere possent, dum Moran Avigny defendunt; tamen, ex ideologia Jebus, Schola Veritatis talia agere abstinebit.

source: That explains why Moran Avigny couldn’t conceal his fear. It’s tantamount to being forsaken.” Lumian gently nodded.
target: Id explicat cur Moran Avigny timorem celare non potuerit. Hoc quasi desertio est. Lumian leniter annuit.

source: Anthony continued his analysis.
target: Anthony analysin suam continuavit.

source: “We must also take into account Moran Avigny’s unique characteristic as a Mirror Person.
target: Praeterea, considerare debemus singularitatem Moran Avigny ut Specularis Hominis.

source: The Mirror People we’ve previously encountered not only pursued their own ambitions but also exhibited a certain zealotry towards their leader and overarching objectives.
target: Speculares, quos antea convenimus, non solum suas ambitiones persequebantur, sed etiam certam fervorem erga ducem suum et metas universales exhibebant.

source: Based on my observations, while Moran Avigny is undeniably terrified, he managed to exercise some restraint. Upon entering the carriage, he appeared resolute and determined.
target: Ex observationibus meis, quamquam Moran Avigny indubitanter territus est, aliquam continentiam servare potuit. In raedam conscendens, constans ac determinatus apparuit.

source: Lumian comprehended and remarked, “Is he contemplating self-sacrifice? He’ll promptly alert the other Mirror People and urge them to swiftly conceal themselves. As for himself, he’s under the strict protection of officials, rendering escape impossible. His only option is to remain in place, visible to the enemy faction, hoping that his fortune is sufficient and the official protection proves effective."
target: Lumian intellexit et inquit: "Num se ipsum immolare cogitat? Celeriter reliquos Speculares certiorem faciet et impellere eos ut celeriter se celent. Quod ad se ipsos attinet, sub stricta tutela officialium est, unde effugere impossibile est. Unica eius optio est in loco manere, hostium factioni conspicuus, sperans fortunam suam satis esse atque tutelam officialem efficacem."

source: Heh heh, in times like these, protection becomes another form of confinement.
target: Heh heh, temporibus talibus, tutela alia forma coercitionis fit.

source: Anthony shifted the topic.
target: Anthony rem mutavit.

source: “Which tributary turned black following the change in Moran Avigny’s fate?”
target: Quis ramus post mutationem fati Moran Avigny in nigrum versa est?

source: Lumian shook his head.
target: Lumian caput negavit.

source: Nothing at present.
target: Nihil ad praesens.

source: This is an exceptionally unique situation. It signifies that it will manifest only when Moran Avigny makes a new choice, branching into a new fate tributary.
target: Hoc est condicionis eximie singularis. Significat manifestari solum, cum Moran Avigny novam electionem faciet, in novum ramum fati convertatur.

source: At this juncture, Lumian exhaled slowly and stated, “I don’t perceive any other opportunities at the moment. It would have been good if the Overseer had acted rashly and protected Moran Avigny. The Demoness of Black should be awaiting him. Hmm, let’s locate Jenna and Franca first.”
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian lente suspiravit et dixit: "Nullas alias opportunitates nunc video. Bene fuisset, si Praefectus impetuose egisset et Moran Avigny protegeret. Daemona Nigra eum exspectare debebat. Hmm, primum Jenna et Francam inveniamus."

source: In the quarry cave housing a permanent entrance to the mirror world, Franca, who had been patiently waiting, witnessed black hair reemerge from the mirror, descending strand by strand.
target: In spelunca fodina, quae ingressum permanentem in mundum specularum continebat, Franca, quae patienter exspectaverat, vidit capillos negros ex speculo iterum emergere, filamenta per filamentum descendentes.

source: Demoness of Black Clarice materialized and spoke softly, “Currently, no Beyonders are concealed behind the relevant mirror. They must have abandoned Moran Avigny."
target: Daemona Nigra Clarice apparuit et leniter locuta est: "Nunc, nulli Beyonders post speculum pertinente absconduntur; forsitan abierunt a Moran Avigny."

source: “I’m unable to provide assistance at this time. You must reevaluate your strategy and devise a means to capture Moran Avigny, who is under the robust protection of official Beyonders, without entering the mirror world.”
target: Non possum auxilium in hoc tempore praebere. Consilium tuum iterum perpendas et viam invenias ad Moran Avigny capiendum, qui sub valida tutela Beyonders officialium est, sine in mundum specularum ingrediendo.

source: Do you have a solution in mind? Franca wished to inquire but refrained out of concern for offending the Demoness of Black.
target: Habesne solutionem in mente? Franca interrogare volebat, sed abstinuit metu ne Daemona Nigra offenderetur.

source: Instead, she simply replied, “Understood.”
target: Pro eo, simpliciter respondit: "Intellectum."

source: In a secure safe house within the administrative district, Jenna informed Lumian and Anthony, “Madame Judgment has instructed us to halt further action for now. She needs to confer with the other Major Arcana card holders regarding the information obtained from Jebus.”
target: In domo securā in regione administrativā, Jenna Lumiano et Anthony nuntiavit: "Domina Iudicium nos iussit ut hactenus actiones ulteriora desinamus. Ea oportet consuetudinem habere cum aliis possessoribus chartarum Major Arcana de notitiis a Jebus receptis."

source: With Ma’am Hermit? Lumian pondered silently, immersed in thought.
target: "Cum Domina Hermit?" Lumian tacite meditatus est.

source: He gave a small nod and said, “Let’s go find Franca.”
target: Parvum annuum dedit et inquit: "Eamus Francam quaerere!"

source: After rendezvousing with Franca in the subterranean quarry cave and sharing their discoveries, Lumian sighed and declared, “For the time being, we have no choice but to abandon our efforts.”
target: Postquam cum Franca in spelunca fodina subterranea conveniissent et inventa sua inter se communicaverunt, Lumian suspiravit et dixit: "Ad tempus, non aliud habemus quam conatus nostros deserere."

source: As Franca and the others nodded in agreement, Lumian suddenly heard a resounding voice.
target: Cum Franca et ceteri consensu annuissent, Lumian subito vocem resonantem audivit.

source: “Don’t you believe you’re capitulating prematurely?
target: Nonne putas te nimis prae-tempore cedere?

source: “Did you fail to notice any issues?”
target: Nonne quaedam difficultates non animadvertisti?

source: Termiboros… Why is He offering me guidance? And it’s not an urgent matter that threatens Him? Lumian couldn’t help but furrow his brow.
target: Termiboros… Cur ille mihi consilium praebet? Et num res urgente eum minatur? Lumian non potuit quin fronte contraxisset.

source: Termiboros’s profound voice persisted, “Consider this. If you were an Overseer, what actions would you take in such a scenario?”
target: Vox profunda Termiboros perseveravit: "Considera hoc. Si praefectus esses, quae actiones in tali casu caperes?"

source: “Naturally, they would reduce personnel and conceal themselves to prevent the enemy from discovering clues and pursuing them…” Lumian muttered under his breath. “Beyond this, what else can they do? How can they indirectly aid Moran Avigny?”
target: "Certe, operarios minuere et se celare conarerentur, ne hostis indicia detegeret et eos persequeretur…" Lumian submurmuravit: "Quid praeter hoc agere possunt? Quomodo indirecte Moran Avigny adiuvare possent?"

source: Franca, Jenna, and Anthony observed Lumian as he mumbled to himself, awaiting his ultimate explanation.
target: Franca, Jenna, et Anthony Lumian conspexerunt, dum sibi ipsi submurmurabat, ultimum suum explanare expectans.

source: Abruptly, a possibility occurred to Lumian.
target: Subito, aliqua possibilitas Lumiano in mentem venit.

source: He gazed at his three companions and said in a low, serious tone, “Under the Table Transaction!”
target: Ad tres comites suos aspexit et voce levi ac seria dixit: "Sub Mensa Transactio!"

source: “Safeguard Moran Avigny through a high-level Under the Table transaction!”
target: "Moran Avigny per transactionem sub mensa altissimi gradus protegendus sit!"

source: “That’s why we each abandoned the plan for distinct reasons. Even the river of fate currently shows no death calamity for Moran Avigny!”
target: "Idcirco singuli consilium nostrum propter causas diversas deseruimus. Etiam flumen fati nunc nullam mortis calamitatem pro Moran Avigny exhibet!"
